svg.title: Naive full-prefix recomputation vs Prefill and KV-Cache decode
svg.desc: Architecture delta comparing naive autoregressive decoding that recomputes K and V for the entire sequence at every step against two-phase Prefill plus static KV-Cache decoding updated via jax.lax.dynamic_update_slice.
svg.text: Recomputes all past K, V tensors on every token
Decouple parallel Prefill from O(T) cached Decode
CHANGED · stepFull prefix [B, T] → single token [B, 1] in Decode
REMOVED · recomputeEliminate redundant K, V projections for 0..t−1
ADDED · kvcacheStatic KV-Cache updated via dynamic_update_slice
CHANGED · attnO(T²) matrix-matrix → O(T) query-vector × cache
REWIRED · r2Route single-step k_t, v_t into static cache slot pos
REMOVED · r3Drop full T×T causal attention recomputation
ADDED · r4Read cached K, V slices [0..pos] with zero drift
Prompt token IDs · Next-token logits (Δ < 1e-5) · r1 · r5
